candidates.title: Review Qt 6.11.2 macOS licensing inventory
criteria: Has the designated owner/legal reviewer approved the distribution terms and corresponding-source/build/relink obligations for this exact Qt 6.11.2 macOS inventory, including equivalent recipient access and retention?
candidates.content: BPR-0962 AC1 only. The owner-selected Qt upgrade changes the licensing/source inventory, so the accepted macOS licensing-v002 decision does not transfer. The ad-hoc universal macOS app retains seven upstream source payloads and 63 Qt package records. QtBase is now 6.11.2, with source archive SHA-256 5b2e00eccaf5a4d8c14134ffa0ea8dfd0a35ae1ffc7f8d87fa4305a1ed23cf22; Qt's Apache Tika MIME XML attribution and its Apache-2.0 notice remain included. The separate version-bound corresponding-source asset model is unchanged: no source ZIP is embedded in the installed application; installed provenance, notices and source offer bind the exact release URL, digest and producer. Both binary and corresponding-source assets must reach every recipient at no extra charge through equivalent access, including offline/corporate copies and a fallback after private-repository access changes. Retention is indefinite until the accountable distribution owner documents that all applicable obligations ended, and never ends while matching binaries remain distributed. Build, Qt replacement/relinking and local verification instructions remain in SOURCE-OFFERS.txt. The prospective v0.1.3 source URL is unpublished. Review first-party distribution terms, mixed syntax-data licenses, upstream/toolchain terms and practical build/relink material for these exact bytes. Approval here does not approve vulnerabilities, security, signatures, native behavior or publication. Fresh Grype remains FAILED with 32 macOS / 30 Windows raw matches; no security-owner waiver exists. Producer 92c4e1594b7a8836d69d79404d1d12a7ddf9bbcf; macOS package SHA-256 65cbeb97be3252c2b7e4346fe8033842671030c660744af41943eeecdffeb22c; SPDX b0b94e7fc1deabf16d0fe59af8ff5d19732cab859fa5887e3477f1258dd09b2c; separate source 2532ba6aaa2137deb709f201faa453214425e52cc3bec5389cbe898210663329. Package/source mechanics pass; legal/owner acceptance remains pending.
